name: VELIKIY POHOD
source:
The Great March is an insane survival game that Semyon and his friends must participate in. The future of not just himself, but the fate of the entire country, depends on his choices and actions. Will he submit to the insane regime, or will he decide to openly challenge it? And, most importantly, will he survive or perish in the abyss of this twisted game?

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3690306081]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《伟大的行军》是谢苗和他的朋友们必须参加的一场疯狂的生存游戏。他的选择和行动不仅决定了他自己的未来，也决定了整个国家的命运。他会屈服于这个疯狂的政权，还是决定公开挑战它？最重要的是，他会在这场扭曲游戏的深渊中生存还是灭亡？

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3690306081]Steam[/url]]
